headline: Coca-Cola Stock Pops After Earnings Shine a Light on Consumer Spending
summary: Coca-Cola  stock was rising on Tuesday after the soft drink company reported better-than-expected earnings and raised its full-year guidance, signaling to investors that demand for fizzy drinks remains robust.  Coca-Cola reported adjusted earnings of 97 cents a share, as revenue jumped 7% from a year ago to $13.4 billion.  Analysts were expecting earnings of 93 cents a share on revenue of $13.2 billion, according to a FactSet poll.

headline: Coca-Cola Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results and Raises Full Year Guidance
summary: ATLANTA, July 28, 2026--The Coca-Cola Company today reported second quarter 2026 results. "We delivered another strong quarter by staying close to the changing needs of our consumers and customers," said Henrique Braun, CEO of The Coca-Cola Company. "While we continue to see a dynamic consumer landscape, we leveraged our powerful brands and system to gain value share, delivering revenue, profit and earnings growth while also investing for the long term."
